items.title: Software Stocks Soar in Rotational Trade: Monday.com Up 7%, HubSpot Up 6%, Intuit Up 5%
items.summary: A sharp selloff in AI hardware names sent money flooding into beaten-down enterprise software stocks Tuesday, lifting Monday.com, HubSpot, and Intuit sharply higher despite a broader tech retreat. The question is whether this rotation signals a genuine reassessment of software's durability or just a single-day trade in deeply wounded names.
